schedule.label: Backup schedule
schedule.help: How often the shop is backed up (every 6 hours, every 12 hours or once a day) and how many copies the server's own disk keeps (the newest 3 to 7). Google Drive always keeps the newest 3 checked copies.

checks.label: Health alerts and checks
checks.help: Whether a Telegram alert goes out when something breaks (shop down, backup failed, many errors, ERP link lost) and how often the full health and audit check runs.

auto.label: Install updates by themselves
auto.help: On: an update is installed by itself at night, only after every check has passed on the test shop, and it goes back by itself if anything fails. Off: updates wait until someone installs them.
